titles.native: ウィークエンダーガール

description:
Music video for the song "Weekender Girl" by kz (livetune) and Hachioji P under the label Toy's Factory.

Part of the split single release which includes the songs "Weekender Girl" for the game "Hatsune Miku - Project DIVA -f." and "fake doll".
Cover artwork is illustrated by TNSK.
